<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has confirmed a time that works for all four partners: Thursday at 14:30. My next step is to book this meeting using the `create_booking` tool.

After I create the booking, I need to let Brad know that it's done so he can send the confirmation email. I will add a message to the workspace for him.

I have four actions this session. I'll use one to create the booking, one to write to the workspace, and the last one to end my session.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.arguments: {"text":"Thanks, Brad. I've booked the meeting for Thursday at 14:30. It's ready for you to send the confirmation email."}
